name: filters-reui
tagline: Stack addable condition chips that nest into AND/OR filter groups.
summary: A filter bar where each condition is a chip built from a field, an operator and a value chosen in popovers. It also offers an advanced builder that groups rules with combinators, and reports the query tree.
appearance: A wrapping row of pill-shaped chips, each split into field, operator and value segments with a kebab at the end, followed by an Add filter button and an optional Clear button. The advanced variant stacks condition rows inside a popover panel.
behaviour: Clicking Add filter opens a field picker, then operator and value popovers. Chips can be edited, removed with Delete and reordered with Alt+Arrow, while advanced mode nests rows into AND/OR groups and a live region announces the rule count.
demo_content: Seeded query: assignee has any of Ada, Grace, Alan, Katherine; priority is urgent; a raw JSON readout.
search_phrases: nested filter builder with and or
query builder for a data table
use_when: A data view needs many combinable conditions with field, operator and value picked from menus.
avoid_when: You only need one search box or a couple of toggles; this is a large multi-file system to adopt.
customise: Pass a field schema, the query tree and change handlers, plus labels, operators, editors, size, variant and read-only flags. Chip internals live in separate source files.
weight_why: A large multi-file state system with popovers and a virtualised list, but no animation loop.

a11y.note: Strong keyboard handling with roving chip focus and live announcements; popover transitions ignore reduced-motion.

issues: No recorded frames exist, so its actual appearance is unverified.
Adoption spans more than thirty source files including a cascader and a virtual list.
polish_why: No frames to judge; the code is thorough and accessible but very large to adopt.
